meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为项目生成分层说明文件,让 AI 编程助手读懂代码结构、命令与约定
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你希望 AI 助手在大型代码库里按目录逐步理解项目并遵循团队约定
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI agents to understand a large codebase by directory and follow team conventions

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会为你的项目生成一组分层的 AGENTS.md 文件:根目录一份,加上按复杂度打分挑出的子目录各一份,记录目录结构、关键命令和项目约定。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把自身结构、命令和约定记录下来供 agent 使用时;你也可以直接运行 /init-deep 开始。

say.text: 运行 /init-deep,给这个仓库生成 AGENTS.md
say.note: 默认更新模式,已存在的文件会被改写

howto.what_en: After install, Claude generates a set of hierarchical AGENTS.md files for your project: one at the root plus one per subdirectory picked by a complexity score, covering layout, key commands and project conventions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands and conventions documented for agents; you can also run /init-deep directly.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep to generate AGENTS.md for this repo
say_en.note: Default update mode; existing files get edited
Reads existing files, deletes them, rebuilds
